name: Breakthrough BB
summary: This EA implements a Bollinger Band breakout strategy that enters trades when price breaks through the upper or lower Bollinger Band. It targets momentum-driven moves after price escapes the BB channel, with stop loss and take profit defined relative to the band width or fixed pip distances.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了布林带突破策略，当价格突破布林带上轨或下轨时入场交易。它针对价格逃离BB通道后的动量驱动行情，使用相对于带宽或固定点数的止损和止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于布林带突破，当价格收盘突破上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空，认为价格突破波动率通道后会延续动量方向运行。入场条件为K线收盘价突破上轨买入或突破下轨卖出，可选择等待突破后回踩再入场以过滤假突破。出场条件包括固定点数止盈止损，或基于布林带宽度的动态止盈止损，部分版本可能包含反向信号平仓逻辑。仓位管理支持固定手数或基于账户余额的动态手数计算，可能包含风险百分比参数。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损设置但未发现马丁格尔或网格加仓机制，整体风险可控但需关注突破失败后的连续亏损风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Bollinger Band breakouts, going long when price closes above the upper band and short when it closes below the lower band, assuming momentum continuation after price escapes the volatility channel. Entry conditions require a candle close beyond the upper band for buy signals or below the lower band for sell signals, with some implementations offering a pullback-after-breakout option to filter false breakouts. Exit conditions include fixed-pip stop loss and take profit, or dynamic levels derived from Bollinger Band width, and some versions may close positions on opposing breakout signals. Position sizing supports fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account balance with a risk percentage parameter. Money management provides stop loss protection without martingale or grid pyramiding mechanisms, keeping overall risk manageable though consecutive losses from failed breakouts remain a concern.
pros: 布林带突破策略逻辑清晰，基于波动率通道的突破在趋势行情中表现良好
提供了止损止盈设置，避免单笔交易无限亏损
参数可调，交易者可根据不同品种和周期优化布林带参数
策略简单直观，易于理解和回测验证
无马丁格尔或网格加仓机制，风险结构相对简单可控
pros_en: Bollinger Band breakout logic is clear and performs well in trending markets based on volatility channel escapes
Stop loss and take profit are provided, preventing unlimited loss on any single trade
Adjustable parameters allow traders to optimize BB settings for different instruments and timeframes
Strategy is straightforward and easy to understand, backtest, and validate
No martingale or grid pyramiding, keeping risk structure relatively simple and manageable
cons: 布林带突破在震荡市中频繁产生假突破信号，导致连续止损
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动期可能过窄
缺乏多时间框架确认，单一周期信号容易受噪音干扰
未发现点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下突破信号可能被吞噬
缺少持仓数量检查和新K线检查，存在重复开仓风险
cons_en: Bollinger Band breakouts generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive stop losses
Fixed stop loss and take profit don't adapt to changing market volatility, potentially too tight during high-volatility periods
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, making single-timeframe signals susceptible to noise
No spread filter detected, meaning breakout profits can be consumed by wide spreads
Missing position count check and new bar check creates risk of duplicate order placement
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认，例如H4趋势方向配合H1突破信号，减少假突破
加入ATR动态止损止盈，使出场水平随市场波动率自适应调整
添加新K线检查和最大持仓数限制，防止同一K线重复开仓和过度暴露
增加点差过滤和震荡指标（如ADX）过滤，避免在窄幅震荡和高点差时入场
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., H4 trend direction with H1 breakout signal, to reduce false breakouts
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit for volatility-adaptive exit levels
Add new bar check and maximum position limit to prevent duplicate entries on the same bar and overexposure
Add spread filter and ranging market filter (e.g., ADX) to avoid entries during narrow consolidation and high spreads

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一根K线上重复开仓，增加风险暴露
固定止损在剧烈波动行情中可能被跳空穿越，实际亏损超过预期
震荡行情中假突破频繁触发导致连续止损累积亏损
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause duplicate orders on the same candle, increasing risk exposure
Fixed stop loss can be gap-overshot during extreme volatility, resulting in actual loss exceeding expectations
Frequent false breakouts in ranging markets trigger consecutive stop losses, accumulating drawdown

It targets momentum-driven moves after price escapes the BB channel, with stop loss and take profit defined relative to the band width or fixed pip distances.
